title: Ffion's Key
summary: Unlocks Ffion’s chest on the second floor of Fraygo’s Flophouse.

fields.Acquisition: Find Ffion’s body under the bed in the attic’s secret room. A DC 10 Investigation check discovers the body.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
